dialogues.jp:
さて、屋上に出たわけだが、陽気がいいので意
外に人があふれている。
dialogues.en:
Here we are on the rooftop. There are quite few people up
here in the fresh air.
dialogues.text:
Here we are on the rooftop. There are quite few people up
here in the fresh air.

dialogues.en: "By the way..."
dialogues.text: "By the way..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は自分の腰元に視線を下ろした。
dialogues.en: I look down at my waist.
dialogues.text: I look down at my waist.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぎゅうぅぅ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Squeeze!"
dialogues.text: "Squeeze!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんでお前は俺の上に座る！」
dialogues.en: "Why do you have to sit on my lap?"
dialogues.text: "Why do you have to sit on my lap?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ……猫は家の中で一番暖かいところで
　ひなたぼっこするんだよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hm... Cats like the warmest spot in the house. Didn't you
know that?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm... Cats like the warmest spot in the house. Didn't you
know that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「関係ない！」
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing to do with this."
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing to do with this."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「関係あるよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it is."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it is."

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、と俺の腕を抱きしめてさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles while holding my arms tightly.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles while holding my arms tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクは世界中で一番安心できるところにいる
　んだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm in the most comfortable place in the world."
dialogues.text: "I'm in the most comfortable place in the world."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうきたか」
dialogues.en: "I see, that's what you wanted to say."
dialogues.text: "I see, that's what you wanted to say."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは♪」
dialogues.en: "Meow... Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Meow... Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
かすかに海の匂いのする風が、心地よく頬をな
でる。
dialogues.en: The ocean breeze tickles me on the cheeks.
dialogues.text: The ocean breeze tickles me on the cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 春だ。
dialogues.en: It's spring.
dialogues.text: It's spring.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夢みたいだよ」
dialogues.en: "I feel I'm still in a dream."
dialogues.text: "I feel I'm still in a dream."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「こんなにお兄ちゃんを感じる日が来るなんて
　……子供のころにも想像しなかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"I never expected to get to be so close to you, even when I
was a child."
dialogues.text:
"I never expected to get to be so close to you, even when I
was a child."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。あ、そうそう、ボクの授業はどうだっ
　たかな？」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Oh, by the way. What did you think of my class?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Oh, by the way. What did you think of my class?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、普通だった」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it was all right."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it was all right."

dialogues.jp: 弁当に視線を動かしつつ頷く。
dialogues.en: I nod and turn my gaze to the lunch box.
dialogues.text: I nod and turn my gaze to the lunch box.

dialogues.jp:
頭を下げると、きめの細かいさくらの髪の匂い
が鼻をつく。
dialogues.en:
When I look down, I caught a breath of the scent of Sakura's
fine hair.
dialogues.text:
When I look down, I caught a breath of the scent of Sakura's
fine hair.

dialogues.jp: それこそ、ひなたの匂いだ。
dialogues.en: It's a scent of sunshine.
dialogues.text: It's a scent of sunshine.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「普通ってなに？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by all right?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by all right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「良かったってことだよ」
dialogues.en: "It means good."
dialogues.text: "It means good."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ホントに？　なんか変なこと言ってなかっ
　た？」
dialogues.en: "Really? Did I say anything wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Really? Did I say anything wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「言ってないよ……ただ、漢字とひらがなの練
　習しなきゃな」
dialogues.en: "You didn't, but you've got to practice writing Japanese."
dialogues.text: "You didn't, but you've got to practice writing Japanese."

dialogues.jp:
小さく笑いながら、空いた手でさくらの頭をな
でる。
dialogues.en: Chuckling quietly, I stroke her head with my other hand.
dialogues.text: Chuckling quietly, I stroke her head with my other hand.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もちろんだよ。がんばるよボク♪」
dialogues.en: "Sure. I'll work on it!"
dialogues.text: "Sure. I'll work on it!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Good."
dialogues.text: "Good."

dialogues.jp:
とても平和だ。まぁ、周囲から目立ってはいた
が、特に問題視されているようには見えない。
dialogues.en:
It's so peaceful. Even though people are looking at us, they
don't seem to be bothered too much.
dialogues.text:
It's so peaceful. Even though people are looking at us, they
don't seem to be bothered too much.

dialogues.jp: いや――おかしい。
dialogues.en: Wait... Something's wrong.
dialogues.text: Wait... Something's wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。チョークって持つの難しいよね。こう、
　ギギギってひきずっちゃうんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. It's hard to hold the chalk, isn't it? I always drag
it like this."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. It's hard to hold the chalk, isn't it? I always drag
it like this."

dialogues.jp:
気づいたが、本当にただ目立っているだけで、
しかし｛・・・・／それ以上｝の視線がない。
dialogues.en:
I realize we really stand out among the others, but that's
about it.
dialogues.text:
I realize we really stand out among the others, but that's
about it.

dialogues.jp:
誰がどう考えたって、好奇とかいぶかしげな視
線があってもいいはずだ。
dialogues.en:
I'd expect them to give us more curious or questioning
looks.
dialogues.text:
I'd expect them to give us more curious or questioning
looks.

dialogues.jp: なければ、おかしいだろう。
dialogues.en: That's what they're supposed to do.
dialogues.text: That's what they're supposed to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん、どうした」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おなか空いた？　お弁当食べようか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you hungry? Shall we eat lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Are you hungry? Shall we eat lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
軽く首をかたむけつつ、かすかな違和感を拭い
去ることが出来なかった。
dialogues.en:
I tilt my head a little, but I can't get rid of the bad
feeling.
dialogues.text:
I tilt my head a little, but I can't get rid of the bad
feeling.

dialogues.jp: 面倒なことにならなければいいが――。
dialogues.en: I hope nothing bad happens.
dialogues.text: I hope nothing bad happens.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを考えつつ、さくらが不器用にお弁
当の包みを開くのを見つめた。
dialogues.en:
With those thoughts running through my head, I watch Sakura
opening the wrapping of her lunch box.
dialogues.text:
With those thoughts running through my head, I watch Sakura
opening the wrapping of her lunch box.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・日向ぼっこ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei in the sun◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei in the sun◆

dialogues.jp:
青空の下で食べるほうが弁当も美味いと、屋上
に出る。
dialogues.en:
We went up on the rooftop to eat our lunch under the blue
sky.
dialogues.text:
We went up on the rooftop to eat our lunch under the blue
sky.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか俺のひざにのるさくら。目立つし、恥ず
かしいことこの上ないのだが、なぜか周囲から
それほど注目はされない。
dialogues.en:
Sakura sat on my lap, which drew people's attention, and it
was embarrassing for me. But I don't know why people weren't
giving us strange looks.
dialogues.text:
Sakura sat on my lap, which drew people's attention, and it
was embarrassing for me. But I don't know why people weren't
giving us strange looks.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、こんなのもいいなぁ、なんて不覚なこと
を考えてしまう日だった。
dialogues.en:
Who cares what they think! That's how I feel on a peaceful
day like this.
dialogues.text:
Who cares what they think! That's how I feel on a peaceful
day like this.
